status: prospective finite-sample mechanism study motivated by prior exploratory algebra; no publication novelty claim

definitions.true_scale: one at every time; targets are independent standardized innovations
definitions.native: s[t]=exp(delta[t]); halfwidth=s[t]*F_abs_inverse(.9), using correct family quantile to isolate scale error
definitions.population: q solves mean_j F_abs(q*exp(delta[t-j]))=.9 for j=1..L; no finite-sample randomness
definitions.iid_bank: n independent draws from the uniform mixture of L historical score distributions; exact order-statistic expectation via Beta quadrature; not a deployable sample bank
definitions.contiguous: q is the specified order statistic of abs(innovation[t-L:t])*exp(-delta[t-L:t]); n=L; paths share innovations across templates/amplitudes/frequencies/windows/rules
definitions.randomized: adjacent ranks with expected rank .9*(n+1); compute each interval's metrics first, then average; no random coin simulation
definitions.evaluation: integrate current innovation analytically to obtain conditional expected coverage,width,interval score; average 64 times within each independent path
definitions.oracle_noise_baseline: exact finite-order-statistic interval risk at delta=0, separately by distribution,n,rank rule
definitions.first_order_predictor: oracle_noise_baseline + C*mean_t(delta[t]-mean_past_L(delta))^2, C=z^2*f_abs(z)/alpha; its fast-minus-slow contrast is fixed before new outcomes
definitions.second_order: also retain exact risk of z*exp(delta[t]-mean(delta)-.5*(1+z*fprime(z)/f(z))*var(delta)); descriptive population approximation
definitions.phase_dependence: 64 phases are dependent within path, not 64 independent replications; period/frequencies deliberately preserve identical native marginal metrics

numerics.refinement: compare coverage,width,IS at all phases; increase nodes in fixed order if tolerance fails; abort at256 if unconverged, do not silently accept

primary.contrast: fast_frequency17 minus slow_frequency1 expected interval score, path paired
primary.bootstrap_unit: whole independent innovation path, same sampled indices for all cases
primary.simultaneous_note: 99.375% individual percentile intervals provide nominal Bonferroni8 familywise95% approximation; bootstrap is Monte Carlo approximation, not arbitrary-distribution coverage theorem

neural_bridge_gate.median_scope: all8 primary cells, including failures and indeterminate directions; denominator floor is a fixed numerical stability convention
neural_bridge_gate.interpretation: predefined feasibility thresholds for a small neural bridge, not proof of novelty or universal accuracy; all implementation and numerical checks must pass

endogenous_boundary.definition: delta[t]=.2*sign(abs(innovation[t-1])-median_abs_innovation); at t0 delta=0; uses strictly past observation
endogenous_boundary.comparison: actual contiguous scores vs independent innovation redraw with the entire issued delta path and current scale held fixed; path-paired conditional expected metrics
endogenous_boundary.interpretation: counterfactual score-bank decoupling, not a deployable calibrator or valid conditional law given learned paths; descriptive boundary stress, not a required gate to make exogenous approximation pass

controls: zero-error finite oracle matches exact rank coverage k/(n+1) within reported Monte Carlo uncertainty
constant log-scale error cancels pathwise for every interval and rank
same-amplitude slow/fast native metrics exactly agree
future perturbations cannot change already-issued contiguous quantiles
independent sort and partition order-statistic implementations agree on toy input
quadrature converges at all retained phase metrics; risk never below true oracle beyond floating tolerance
decision: If primary gate passes, freeze a small new-data/new-seed neural bridge before training. If it fails, preserve failures and investigate the specific finite-sample mismatch before neural training; do not change thresholds or select a successful subset.
